items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: I got to see Bix all the time there; he was with Goldkette, now---

ctx.x: ---they were a very vicious bunch of rum runners--- and, so, we stayed there oh, a month or so. But, I got to see Bix all the time there; he was with Goldkette, now---
Bix and Frankie Trumbauer and all those guys---
